items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 13:1
items.html: The root of the Nukva is in the Atara of the Yesod of ZA, as is known. This is because the Malchut was there at the time of the Nekudim, when the ZAT were in the discernment of a single line, as is customary in the first Tzimtzum, where Malchut is beneath all the nine Sefirot, and the nine Sefirot are all pure of the discernment of restriction and coarseness, as is known. And this Malchut is the secret of complete judgment, on account of which there was the breaking of the vessels, as is known. However, at the time of correction, the ZAT rose in the secret of pregnancy in the womb of Bina, in the secret of ‘three within three,’ NHY within HGT, and the Atara of the Yesod was included in the Tifferet, which is the Bina of the five Hassadim, and the quality of mercy was joined with judgment, since the bottom Hey that was in the Atara of the Yesod was included in the first Hey that is in Tifferet, which is the quality of mercy, and the Malchut was sweetened. Nevertheless, since the root of the Malchut was there, an internality and an externality are discerned in it, which is the secret of the two skins that are upon the Atara of the Yesod, since its root, being from the quality of judgment, still remains there in the discernment of externality, and this skin must be removed from there, since the external forces, called orla [foreskin], have a great hold there, which is the secret of circumcision, after one is born and comes out into the air of the world. Therefore the Mochin of the phase of pregnancy are discerned as complete judgments, because, although the bottom Hey has already been sweetened by the quality of mercy as above, the orla has not yet been removed from there; therefore these three Sefirot NHY of the fetus, included in HGT, are discerned as the three years of orla, and mercy cannot be revealed in the Partzuf until the orla is removed from there. (Item 86).
